name: ai-coding-productivity-evidence
title: AI Coding Productivity Evidence Base
description: PRISMA-structured systematic-review corpus behind "How Much Does AI Improve Software Development Productivity?": search logs, screening and eligibility registers, risk-of-bias appraisals and evidence-weight grades for 181 source documents (116 empirical studies, 46 productivity/delivery effect estimates) on AI-assisted software development, spanning 1 January 2022 to 31 July 2026.

sources.title: How Much Does AI Improve Software Development Productivity?

resources.name: evidence-weight-register
resources.title: Study-level evidence-weight register
resources.description: One evidence-weight grade (high/moderate/low) per empirical study, combining risk of bias with outcome directness, precision and relevance. Canonical study-level register: 116 rows (44 productivity/delivery, 72 adjacent-outcome).

fields.name: study_id
fields.description: Stable study identifier, ST-01 to ST-116.

fields.name: effect_ids
fields.description: Linked productivity effect identifier(s), e.g. E-01; ST-29 and ST-31 each carry two.

fields.name: overall_risk_of_bias
fields.description: Risk-of-bias judgement in the instrument's own vocabulary (e.g. Low, Some concerns, Moderate, Serious, High).

enum: JBI quasi-experimental checklist with prespecified overall-risk rule
JBI analytical cross-sectional/cohort checklist with prespecified overall-risk rule
JBI-derived software benchmark/case checklist with prespecified overall-risk rule

fields.name: grade_source
fields.description: File this grade was consolidated from.

resources.name: operating-model-audit
resources.title: Effect-level operating-model and plotting audit
resources.description: One row per productivity/delivery effect estimate (E-01 to E-46), classifying the automation operating model and whether the effect is plotted as a ratio in the study-results graph.

fields.name: evidence_weight
fields.description: Note: this file spells the middle grade 'medium'; evidence-weight-register.csv spells the same grade 'moderate'. Terminology inconsistency in the source data, not a modelling choice.

resources.name: existing-corpus
resources.title: Locked pre-update corpus
resources.description: The 115-document corpus retained from the article's initial version, with its original publication-source grouping. Baseline that the OpenAlex and journal search streams were deduplicated against.

resources.name: search-log
resources.title: OpenAlex query log
resources.description: Exact OpenAlex query strings, dates, fields searched and result counts for the 14 archived title/abstract queries.

resources.name: openalex-records
resources.title: Raw OpenAlex record snapshot
resources.description: Newline-delimited raw OpenAlex API records for the 29 July 2026 search snapshot. Unstructured/semi-structured source dump underlying screening-register.openalex_id; not every screening-register row has a corresponding record here (existing-corpus rows predate this snapshot).

resources.name: screening-register
resources.title: Master OpenAlex-stream screening and decision register
resources.description: Deduplicated record register spanning identification through report-level eligibility for the agentic-web and OpenAlex streams (948 rows).

fields.name: openalex_id
fields.description: OpenAlex work identifier; links to openalex-records.jsonl where present.

fields.name: query_ids
fields.description: Semicolon-separated search-log.query_id value(s) that surfaced this record; not a single-value foreign key.

resources.name: full-text-candidates
resources.title: OpenAlex-stream reports advanced to full-text assessment
resources.description: The 69 reports advanced from screening-register to eligibility assessment. Byte-identical to report-assessments.csv: every candidate received its decision in place, so no rows were dropped between the two pipeline stages.

resources.name: report-assessments
resources.title: OpenAlex-stream report-level decision and exclusion register
resources.description: Final report-level eligibility decisions, exclusion reasons and stable study/effect ID assignment for the 69 assessed reports. Byte-identical to full-text-candidates.csv (see that resource's description).

resources.name: search-summary
resources.title: Aggregate OpenAlex-stream and corpus-wide counts
resources.description: Current aggregate PRISMA counts (identification through inclusion) for the agentic-web/OpenAlex stream and the combined corpus, as cited in the article.

resources.name: journal-search-log
resources.title: Direct journal (Crossref) search log
resources.description: Per-venue Crossref enumeration parameters and result counts for the 15 named software-engineering journals, searched by ISSN.

resources.name: journal-records
resources.title: Raw Crossref record snapshot
resources.description: Compressed newline-delimited raw Crossref records for the 31 July 2026 direct journal search, tagged with the originating journal_search_id/name/issn (journal-search-log.venue_id).

resources.name: journal-screening-register
resources.title: Journal-stream screening and decision register
resources.description: All topical journal-search candidates (659 rows), deduplication status against the existing corpus, and title/abstract decisions.

resources.name: journal-full-text-candidates
resources.title: Journal-stream reports advanced to full-text assessment
resources.description: The 30 journal reports advanced from journal-screening-register to eligibility assessment. Byte-identical to journal-report-assessments.csv (see that resource's description).

resources.name: journal-report-assessments
resources.title: Journal-stream report-level decision register
resources.description: Final report-level eligibility decisions for the 30 assessed journal reports. Byte-identical to journal-full-text-candidates.csv (see that resource's description).

resources.name: journal-search-summary
resources.title: Aggregate journal-stream counts
resources.description: Aggregate PRISMA counts for the direct journal (Crossref) search stream only.

resources.name: risk-of-bias-register
resources.title: Study-level risk-of-bias domain register
resources.description: One domain-judgement row per empirical study (117 rows, ST-01 to ST-116; two studies each contribute a paired-estimate row), routed to RoB 2, ROBINS-I, a JBI checklist or a JBI-derived benchmark/case checklist per study design. Kept deliberately separate from evidence-weight-register: risk of bias judges internal validity only, not directness, precision or relevance.

fields.name: target_results
fields.description: The specific reported result this assessment targets.

enum: JBI quasi-experimental checklist with prespecified overall-risk rule
JBI analytical cross-sectional/cohort checklist with prespecified overall-risk rule
JBI-derived software benchmark/case checklist with prespecified overall-risk rule

fields.name: profile
fields.description: Study-design profile used for routing to an instrument.

fields.name: overall_risk_of_bias
fields.description: Qualitative overall judgement in the routed instrument's own vocabulary.

resources.name: risk-of-bias-summary
resources.title: Study-level risk-of-bias totals
resources.description: Aggregate counts of overall risk-of-bias judgements by routed instrument, as cited in the article's risk-of-bias section.
